title: Tarn Icewind (Seasonal)
summary: Face seasonal Tarn with the portal already activated, then break his crystal support.
overview: Face seasonal Tarn with the portal already activated, then break his crystal support.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Control the crystal targets and recurring add pairs while maintaining the boss tank.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The seasonal controller automatically completes the four portal activation signals and summons Tarn.
Defeat all four attackable crystals to lower his regeneration.
Two reinforcements arrive every minute during combat.
Ten minutes out of combat resets the event; a seasonal victory also summons its completion NPC.

notes: Approval E401. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
